mentions.heading: Cybersecurity incidents and IT system disruptions
mentions.risk_name: Cybersecurity breach and data privacy liability
mentions.detail: Disruption could affect vehicle systems supplied and plants; exposure under EU GDPR, China PIPL, India IT Act, California CCPA
mentions.quote: To the extent that our business is interrupted, including the vehicle systems and components that we supply to our customers or our plant operations, or data is lost, destroyed or inappropriately accessed, used or disclosed, such disruptions could adversely affect our competitive position, operating capacity, ability to provide our goods and services, relationships with our customers, financial condition, operating results and cash flows

drivers.name: European Union General Data Privacy Regulation

mentions.heading: Dependence on third parties' security measures
mentions.detail: Relies on customers, suppliers and service providers' security; limited monitoring ability; damages recovery may be insufficient
mentions.quote: Our ability to monitor these third parties' information security practices is limited, and these third parties may not have adequate information security measures in place.

mentions.heading: Pandemics and public health crises have disrupted our business
mentions.detail: Past suspension of operations; risks of component shortages, labor disruption, demand decline, impaired credit access
mentions.quote: Any such events may adversely impact our global supply chain and global manufacturing operations and cause us to again suspend our operations.

mentions.heading: Stakeholder perspectives on climate change and sustainability
mentions.quote: Our failure, or that of our supply base, to adequately meet stakeholder expectations or address stakeholder concerns, including concerns about environmental impacts and similar matters, may result in, among other things, negative sentiment toward us or our products, the loss of business, diluted market valuation, an inability to attract customers or an inability to attract and retain top talent.

mentions.heading: Global climate change could adversely affect our business
mentions.detail: Extreme weather could affect material availability and cost, insurance costs, facility siting
mentions.quote: Such effects could disrupt our operations by, among other things, impacting the availability and cost of materials needed for manufacturing and could increase insurance and other operating costs.

mentions.heading: Impairment charges relating to goodwill and long-lived assets
mentions.quote: We regularly monitor our goodwill and long-lived assets for impairment indicators.
